name: battle-report
description: RPG-style battle report after each turn: tokens, edits, lines changed and tool errors, as a toast, a notification and a sound

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play Glass (clean turn) or Basso (tool errors or a failed turn) with afplay on macOS

notify.title: Notification
notify.description: Send the report as a native notification as well as a toast

quietTurns.title: Quiet turns
quietTurns.description: Skip the report for a turn that answered without calling any tool
